scope.scope_limit: System presence and layout were inspected; this is not a measure-by-measure or note-by-note transcription. Printed numeric marks have not been normalized into an authoritative measure map.

notation_observations.clef: Treble clef is printed at the start of the movement on physical page 14 and at the continuation on physical page 15; no clef change was identified in these two pages.
notation_observations.key_signature: No key-signature sharps or flats are printed after the clef at the inspected system starts. This observation does not establish concert key or horn transposition.
notation_observations.local_accidentals: Explicit sharps, flats, and naturals are visible within the part. Their complete measure-by-measure effects and carry rules were not audited.
notation_observations.time_signature: The movement opening appears to print 2/4. Meter continuity and every bar's rhythmic contents have not been independently verified.
notation_observations.pitch_domain: Pitch samples below are written treble-clef pitches only. Sounding pitch is not asserted from these pages.

uncertainties_and_limits: Only three isolated written pitches were directly cross-checked; the remaining Horn II notes, rests, ties, articulations, tuplets, dynamics, and durations were not independently verified.
Multi-measure rests and repeat/ending structures occur on both pages. Their expansion and exact temporal alignment were not verified.
The apparent opening 2/4 meter and subsequent rhythmic interpretation require a complete bar-by-bar audit before any timing claim.
Printed cue notes and part notes require complete source-by-source separation before transcription or playback.
No sounding-pitch conversion or tempo map was verified from these two pages alone.
